column1: # C files deliberately kept inside a library that already has a build.zig.
# Enforced by scripts/checks/check_zig_parallel_trees.py, so a port that
# leaves C behind has to say so here instead of leaving a parallel tree.
# A .c under a library's tests/ needs no row: C test fixtures are how the Zig
# is held to the C ABI, and they are deliberately C.

column3: Compile-time conformance TU for the fw_os port contract; a header with no translation unit behind it is never compiled and rots.

Emits the NS image's ra8_ns_rot_header_t record; stays C on purpose, as tests/cmake/zig_libraries.cmake records, so the magic word and struct shape are compiler-checked instead of hand-assembled in the NS linker scripts.

column1: # ra8_jpeg is partially migrated by #2786: the ra8_imgdec backend binding is Zig,
# the codec proper is still C. Five TUs, one shared internal header, one block.

column3: Baseline JPEG codec, not the imgdec seam: the marker walk and the SOF/SOS/DHT/DQT table state behind src/ra8_jpeg_sw_internal.h. The five codec TUs share that 830-line header by value and port as one block, tracked separately from #2786; only the ra8_imgdec backend binding is Zig so far.

Whole-buffer baseline decoder: Huffman tables, the dequantise and IDCT path, upsampling. Shares src/ra8_jpeg_sw_internal.h with the other four codec TUs, so it ports with them rather than piecemeal; #2786 moved only the ra8_imgdec backend binding.

Baseline JPEG encoder entry point and its quality/quantisation setup. Shares src/ra8_jpeg_sw_internal.h with the decoder and the streaming driver, so the encoder ports as part of the one codec block, not alongside the #2786 seam slice.

Bitstream emitter for the encoder: Huffman code emission, byte stuffing, marker writing. Internal to the encoder and reached only through src/ra8_jpeg_sw_internal.h, so it has no separate C ABI and ports with the codec block rather than on its own.

Bounded-memory striped decoder driving the same core as the whole-buffer path. Holds the stripe cursor across calls through src/ra8_jpeg_sw_internal.h, so splitting it from the other codec TUs would put the shared decoder state across a language boundary mid-port.
